description: Sprint 7 features: persistent glossary with backend integration, batch bubble editing, version history per page, and translation confidence indicator
steps: Create store/useGlossaryStore.ts - zustand store persisted to localStorage. State: glossaryEntries (array of {source, target, notes}). Actions: addEntry, editEntry, deleteEntry, importCSV, exportCSV, clearAll.

Add 4th tab 'Glossario' to features/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx. Tab UI: table showing entries with source/target/notes columns, inline add/edit/delete buttons, CSV import button (file input), CSV export button (generates and downloads CSV).
Update TabId type in SettingsPanel.tsx to include 'glossario'.
Backend: Add optional 'glossary' field to PipelineOptions in backend/app/schemas/pipeline.py as list[dict] with source/target/notes fields.
Backend: In backend/app/providers/gemini.py, if glossary is provided in options, append glossary instructions to the system prompt (e.g. 'Use these term translations: source -> target').
Backend: In backend/app/providers/openai.py, if glossary is provided in options, append glossary instructions to the system prompt similarly.
Frontend: Pass glossary entries from useGlossaryStore into the pipeline request (in features/translator/useTranslatePipeline.ts when building the request body).

Create components/BatchBubbleToolbar.tsx - floating toolbar that appears when multiple bubbles are selected. Shows: font family, bold, italic, font size, delete all selected. Applies changes to all selected bubbles.

In components/MangaViewer.tsx: add selectedBubbleIds state (Set<string>). Ctrl+Click on a bubble adds/removes from selection. When multiple selected, render BatchBubbleToolbar instead of ViewerToolbar.

Add translationVersions to useSessionStore: Record<string, TextBubble[][]> keyed by image id, max 5 versions per page. Add actions: saveVersion(imageId), restoreVersion(imageId, versionIndex), getVersions(imageId).
Add 'Versoes' dropdown button in MangaViewer toolbar area - shows list of saved versions with timestamps, clicking restores that version's bubbles.
Add optional 'confidence?: number' field to TextBubble interface in types.ts.
Backend: Add optional confidence field to TextBubble in backend/app/schemas/common.py.
Backend: In OCR prompts (gemini.py and openai.py), request confidence score (0-1) for each bubble in the JSON response schema.
Frontend: In components/BubbleOverlay.tsx, show an orange dot indicator when bubble.confidence exists and is < 0.7. Position it at top-right corner of the bubble.
Run npm run typecheck && npm run lint to verify zero errors
Commit with message: feat(sprint7): glossary, batch bubble edit, version history, confidence indicator
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
npm run lint passes with zero errors (warnings OK)
npm run build produces dist/ successfully
Gemini and OpenAI providers append glossary to prompts
Version history stored in useSessionStore with max 5 per page
BubbleOverlay shows orange dot for low confidence
